claim_boundary: explicit DaveML source versus downstream family-library layer dispositions; not flight qualification

actuators.rationale: The promoted DAVE-ML plant exposes command channels; the first-order position/rate overlay is separately qualified and remains downstream policy.

controllers.rationale: The source-channel LQR and bounded smoke objectives pass as a Taoryx overlay; no source controller claim is made.

mission.rationale: Mission logic is outside the source package and requires a separate scenario contract.

reductions.rationale: Point-mass and pseudo-6DOF reports are promoted only as a local linearized projection and bounded surrogate response.

actuators.rationale: The source provides direct surface inputs but no physical actuator dynamics.

allocation.rationale: Logical surface allocation is not declared by the authoritative aerodynamic source.

controllers.rationale: No controller is promoted from an uncontrolled source plant.

reductions.rationale: No reduced-order equivalence report has been promoted from the parent plant.

controllers.rationale: The authoritative two-stage source is an open-loop trajectory package with no controls.

reductions.rationale: Translation replay is bounded against retained ECI telemetry; attitude pseudo-6DOF remains explicitly deferred.

controllers.rationale: OpenAP performance data does not provide source-exact actuator or controller dynamics.

matched_comparison.rationale: Derived-exact performance and surrogate-composite common channels match at declared operating points; rotational authorities remain separate.

objectives.rationale: The family exposes scored performance objectives.

trim.rationale: The derived-exact point-mass family has a reproducible reference trim.

tuning.rationale: The family exposes bounded performance tuning evidence.

actuators.rationale: Bounded Taoryx actuator policy is explicitly part of the surrogate contract.

canonical_daveml_export.rationale: Taoryx-authored surrogate documents round-trip in a fresh process.

full_rigidbody_6dof.rationale: The current qualification is pseudo-6DOF and does not claim full rigid-body source equivalence.

matched_comparison.rationale: The surrogate-composite lane shares OpenAP translational performance with the derived-exact baseline and is compared without merging rotational authority.

stability_augmentation.rationale: Bounded Taoryx stability augmentation is explicitly part of the surrogate contract.
